verdict.rationale: Jeeves ships an MCP server that lets AI assistants/agents take financial actions (query spend, pay vendors, submit reimbursements) on behalf of a user, which supports agentic automation, plus some built-in business-process automation (auto-emailing for missing receipts, automating invoice approval flows). However, there is no documentation of scheduling, triggers, or truly autonomous background execution loops—MCP actions appear to be invoked per-request by an assistant rather than persistent unattended jobs. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/recurring autonomous runs, trigger-based automation setup, and confirmation that MCP-driven actions can execute without a live agent session.
